title: ToolsPanel re-theme: tool buttons have inconsistent up/active state styling + no hover state (regression from f27bb24)
description:
REGRESSION from f27bb24 ("Wave B top chrome ... ToolsPanel -> light Halo"). Two related interaction-STATE styling bugs in packages/authoring-ui/src/ToolsPanel.tsx tool buttons. A static screenshot misses both (a prior visual check passed); reproduced with real hover/click via Playwright on :1420.

=== REPRO (Playwright, drive real hover/click + computed-style introspection) ===
Loaded editor on :1420, located tool grid buttons (button[title], e.g. 'Selection (V)', 'Line (N)', 'Oval (O)').

BUG 1 — up/active inconsistency + STALE styling when switching tools:
- INITIAL never-selected tool ('up'): borders are transparent (rgba(0,0,0,0) 1px solid) — correct flat look.
- Click 'Line' (it goes active = sunken bevel, correct), then click 'Oval'. Now 'Line' is deselected but its computed border = 'rgb(0,0,0) 2px OUTSET' — a BLACK 2px outset frame stuck on it. The previously-active button does NOT return to the same flat 'up' appearance as a never-selected button.
  * Reset-to-up consistent (Selection-after-deselect == Line-never-selected-up)?  FALSE
  * Active consistent (initial Selection == post-click Line)?  TRUE (active state itself is fine)
- Visible in screenshot: after clicking Oval, the Oval is sunken (correct) but Line shows a dark box/border residue that Pen/Pencil (never selected) do not. Matches the user's 'weird UP-state styling inconsistent with INITIAL state; clicking one tool then another causes weird styling.'

BUG 2 — no hover state:
- Hovering a non-active tool ('Line') changes nothing: background and all four border colors identical before vs during hover (HOVER changed anything? FALSE). No visual feedback at all. Matches 'tool buttons have no HOVER state.'

=== ROOT CAUSE (file:line) ===
packages/authoring-ui/src/ToolsPanel.tsx:

BUG 1 — React shorthand/longhand border conflict:
- styles.toolBtn (line ~317) sets the SHORTHAND:  border: '1px solid transparent'.
- styles.toolBtnActive (line ~324-328) spreads bevel('sunken') which emits the FOUR LONGHAND props (borderTop/Left/Right/Bottom) — see theme/flash8Theme.ts bevel() ~L251.
- Per-button style is {...toolBtn, ...(isActive ? toolBtnActive : {})} (line ~567-570).
- When a button goes active->up, React rewrites the 'border' shorthand but does NOT clear the longhand borderTop*/etc it previously set on the element's inline style (React does not know the shorthand should override stale longhands). The browser is left with leftover bevel longhand values, rendering as '2px outset black'. Result: a black frame sticks to every tool ever selected.
- Same longhand/shorthand mix affects styles.objectDrawingBtn / objectDrawingBtnActive (~L391/L407, OD toggle also uses bevel('sunken')) and the optBtnStyle() helper (~L476: active branch bevel('sunken') vs inactive branch shorthand 'border: 1px solid transparent') used by pencil/free-transform/lasso/polystar option toggles.

BUG 2 — hover dropped entirely:
- toolBtn is a plain inline style with NO :hover (inline styles cannot carry :hover) and the <button> has NO onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave (line ~565-577). The old dark theme also had no hover, but the re-theme is the point at which Halo hover should have been added.

=== REGRESSION CONFIRMATION ===
git show f27bb24~1: pre-re-theme toolBtn (up) AND toolBtnActive BOTH used the same SHORTHAND 'border' ('1px solid transparent' vs '1px solid #888'). Shorthand<->shorthand diffs cleanly, so active->up fully reverted the border and the up state was consistent. f27bb24 switched the active style to bevel('sunken') (longhand), introducing the shorthand/longhand mix that strands the border. So Bug 1 is a direct f27bb24 regression; Bug 2 (no hover) is a re-theme omission (Flash 8 / docs/30 Halo expects a hover highlight, e.g. rollOverColor #B2E1FF; buttonStyle('over') exists in flash8Theme.ts).

=== EXPECTED vs ACTUAL (Flash 8 / docs/30-flash8-ui-spec.md §3.1) ===
EXPECTED: consistent flat 'up' state for ALL non-active tools (whether or not previously selected); exactly ONE clearly-pressed (sunken-bevel) active tool; a hover highlight on mouse-over of a non-active button.
ACTUAL: previously-selected tools keep a stale black 2px outset border (multiple buttons look 'framed'); no hover feedback at all.

=== FIX DIRECTION ===
1. Drive up/active styling SOLELY from the active-tool state with NO shorthand/longhand mix. Either: (a) make toolBtn use the SAME longhand border props as bevel (set borderTop/Left/Right/Bottom: '1px solid transparent' in the up style so active just overrides the four colors), or (b) have toolBtnActive supply a full shorthand 'border' instead of bevel()'s longhands, or (c) always render explicit longhand borders in both branches. Apply the same fix to objectDrawingBtn(Active) and optBtnStyle() (its inactive branch already uses shorthand 'border: 1px solid transparent' while the active branch uses bevel longhands — same trap).
2. Add a Halo hover state: a raised/highlight (e.g. rollOverColor #B2E1FF bg or a raised bevel via bevel('raised')) on mouse-over of non-active tool buttons, via onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave local state or a CSS class with :hover. Mirror buttonStyle('over') idiom from flash8Theme.ts.

Acceptance: a Playwright run driving hover+click confirms (a) every deselected tool's computed border matches a never-selected tool's (no stale outset), (b) exactly one sunken-active tool at a time, (c) hover changes bg/border on a non-active button.
